For each ruling below write a note of exactly two sentences, 60 to 400 characters in all.
Sentence 1: what the frames show that bears on the rule; it must contain the rule's title exactly as quoted below.
Sentence 2: the measured fact that decided the script's verdict, taken from the script's evidence (for unable_to_rule, the fact that could not be measured).
Describe only: give no verdict of your own and do not dispute the script's. Never use the words compliant, collision, scrape, speeding. Name no file.

- id: structure_contact; title: "Do not touch racking or other structures"; on video: The truck or its load meets racking, an upright, a guard, a column or stacked stock. A consequence within half a second (the structure shifts, something falls, the truck stops abruptly) is the evidence that the touch was real; a touch with no visible consequence is still a breach of this rule.; script verdict: clear; missing fact: none; ruled frames: none; script evidence: "The truck's footprint never held within 0.30 m of a marked structure base for 3 frames: closest 0.62 m to the left_rack base, longest run 0 frame(s); 0 consequence event(s) seen."

Answer with one JSON object only, keyed by rule id: {"<rule id>": "<note>", ...}.
